emotional_tone: Empathetic, poetic, delicate, ethereal, never salesy, atmospheric.

rules: No generic sans fonts for headings. Always use Cormorant Garamond for display.
Headings should use fluid scaling but never exceed text-6xl.
Masked line-by-line reveal for hero text.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. Elements should breathe.
layouts.home_cards: 3 large un-cramped cards for (Il libro, Le 7 notti, La lettera). Use a responsive grid (1 col mobile, 3 cols desktop) with tall aspect ratios (e.g., aspect-[3/4]).
layouts.spotlight_cover: For /libro, the cover image takes a prominent, slightly offset sticky position while narrative scrolls.
layouts.letter_page: Centered poetic alignment, minimal UI. Focus entirely on the textarea and the emotional act of writing.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. It gives the necessary weight and poetic pacing.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Framer motion for text reveal: split text by lines, translateY with stagger and opacity.
motion_and_interactions.floating_butterfly: Framer motion animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0], rotate: [-2, 2, -2] }} with slow, repeating transition.
motion_and_interactions.candle_pulse: CSS animation or Framer Motion for a slow opacity pulse (0.6 to 1) on gold accent glows.
motion_and_interactions.wind_petals: On /lettera submission, trigger a framer-motion sequence for petals blowing away across the screen before PDF download.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle parallax on background starry textures and the solitary tree/ocean covers.

sections: Hero: Night sky, stars, golden butterfly, text 'Se la sera tutto diventa più difficile…'
Cards: 3 large linkable cards (Il libro, Le 7 notti, La lettera)
YouTube embed section with delicate borders
Slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee) with emotional quotes
CTA to Amazon (Link provided by user, NO prices)
Preview of the 7 nights with quotes
CTA to Beacons (Button active with placeholder 'in arrivo', NO prices)
Textarea styled like vintage paper for letter to a lost loved one
Submit action: Animation of wind/petals flying away
Client-side PDF download using jspdf and html2canvas

night_sky_texture.description: Starry night sky texture for the hero background
night_sky_texture.usage: Background layer with low opacity and slight parallax

candle_light.usage: Use as a glowing accent or section background with mix-blend-screen

golden_butterfly.usage: Floating near the Sabrina M. signature. Mask out background or use CSS drop-shadow to make it glow.

paper_texture.usage: Background for the letter textarea in /lettera

falling_petals.usage: Use individually extracted in the Framer Motion wind animation, or as a texture overlay.

book_cover_placeholder_1.description: Solitary tree silhouette in night fog
book_cover_placeholder_1.usage: Placeholder cover for 'Il dolore ha il tuo nome' book

components_and_libraries.framer_motion: For page transitions, scroll reveals, floating butterfly, and the wind/petals animation.
components_and_libraries.lenis: For smooth scrolling. Wrap the app or layout in a ReactLenis component.
components_and_libraries.react_fast_marquee: For the slow editorial text marquee.
components_and_libraries.html2pdf_or_jspdf: For client-side PDF generation in the /lettera page. html2canvas + jspdf is reliable.
components_and_libraries.shadcn_ui: Use sparingly. Buttons should be highly customized (pill-shaped, gold accents, no harsh backgrounds).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: You MUST use .js and .jsx files. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) files, despite what the user's raw prompt says.
No prices should be displayed anywhere. This is a delicate, emotional experience.
Ensure the hero has a dark, starry atmosphere with a glowing, pulsing candle effect (CSS box-shadow/radial-gradient) and a floating butterfly.
Use Framer Motion to mask and reveal the hero text line-by-line: 'Se la sera tutto diventa più difficile…'
Add 'Sabrina M.' as a signature text with the butterfly near it (No photos of Sabrina).
In /libro, highlight the cover and tell the story of the 4 parts beautifully with high contrast elegant typography.
In /lettera, provide a textarea. On submit, trigger a wind/petal animation (framer-motion elements flying top-right) and download the letter as PDF.
Use generous padding, deep dark blue/black backgrounds, and gold text accents.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, textareas, links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Create an extraordinary, delicate, and deeply emotional UI.
Never apply universal transition: all. Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Empty space is emotional space.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under text unless heavily blurred with backdrop-filter or darkened.
Always include the provided image URLs as placeholders until user assets arrive.
